messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — oncall-sre (ashley) NewBridge PROD: VPC app-gateway streaming (ws) errors — elevated disconnects and 502 resets for tenant newbridge-prod, 10:03 UTC. page: oncall-sre, eng-runtime, eng-platform.
ashley: acked — jumping in. can someone share current error % and recent deploys?
raj: pulling logs now. initial look: downstream reset_count spike around 10:01, a lot of `WS_CLOSE` with code 1006 and `502 gateway reset` in proxy logs.
maria: metric dump: 10:00–10:04 window: newbridge-prod ws error rate ~7.3% (baseline <0.2%). connection duration median dropped from 45s to 6s. we had a config rollout to `gateway-proxy v2.3.1` at 09:58 for keepalive change.
lia: customer-ops on call with NewBridge BD — they report ~1.2k active streaming sessions, roughly 150-200 failing, customers seeing partial transcripts. they want ETA.
tim: guessing keepalive + connection pool sizing + retry storm on appgw side. two immediate mitigations: 1) enable per-tenant SSE fallback, 2) throttle client retry window at LB. can we toggle quickly?
ashley: agreed. i'm going to enable sse fallback for newbridge-prod and reduce proxy keepalive to 20s as a temporary. rolling now.
ashley: run: ```bash
kubectl -n appgw patch configmap newbridge-proxy --type merge -p '{"data":{"sse_fallback":"true","keepalive_secs":"20"}}'
```
raj: logs after patch: seeing initial reconnects then fewer immediate resets. still seeing bursts of 502 from dedicated-4 pool worker pod `dedicated-4-7f9c`.
maria: scaling dedicated pool for tenant isolation — increasing replicas for `dedicated-4` from 2 -> 4 to absorb bursts. command: `orch scale pool dedicated-4 --replicas 4 --tenant newbridge-prod` (applying).
incident-bot: ACTION — scale job submitted by maria (job id: sj-20260317-1012). oncall: please confirm.
ashley: confirmed. also applying short-term rate-limit rule to newbridge-prod route: `retry_limit=3, backoff=exponential(100ms, 2s)` to avoid thundering herd.
lia: informing customer: "we've enabled SSE fallback and scaled capacity; you should see improvement within a few minutes. ops team is continuing to monitor."
raj: 10:18 UTC metrics: ws error rate down to 1.1%, 502 resets reduced. connections successful for previously failing clients using SSE fallback.
maria: note: the v2.3.1 keepalive config likely exposed an incompatibility with some app gateways that aggressively close long-lived sockets — need full regression test matrix.
tim: leaving a temporary route flag: `tenant:newbridge-prod -> fallback:sse` until RCA complete. also flagging possible kernel-level socket timeout mismatch with their gateway.
ashley: handing to follow-up oncall for RCA and postmortem: @tim please own RCA and customer comms. i'll mark this incident as mitigated and annotate timeline.
tim: will take it. creating postmortem ticket and scheduling 1:1 with NewBridge infra. thanks team. :thumbsup: 
lia: customer ack: "service restored for most users, appreciate quick mitigation." will request formal notes from your team for our execs.
raj: monitoring continues, will alert if error rate creeps >2% again.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. severity downgraded from P1 to P2 at 10:25 UTC. pager cleared for oncall-sre.
